( #{item.orderId}, #{item.skuId}, #{item.productName}, #{item.skuName}, #{item.salePrice}, #{item.quantity}, 0, 0, #{item.createBy}, sysdate(), #{item.remark} )
mapper.update: update biz_sale_order_item set refunded_quantity = refunded_quantity + #{quantity}, update_by = #{operator}, update_time = sysdate() where item_id = #{itemId} and refunded_quantity + #{quantity} <= quantity

update biz_sale_order_item set refunded_amount = refunded_amount + #{amount}, update_by = #{operator}, update_time = sysdate() where item_id = #{itemId} and refunded_amount + #{amount} <= sale_price * quantity
